label: <DEL> step of short sequences (L=3-4)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively (99.5% of mass) on the delimiter step, and only when the sequence is short: nearly every L=3 sequence fires, about 60% of L=4, about 8% of L=5, and essentially never for L>=6. Magnitude is largest for L=3 (mean per activation ~2.4x that of L=4); the top examples are all L=3 with first token among b/i/h/s, and first tokens b,h,i,s,d raise the rate while sequences with more digits lower it (no digits: 65% of mass). Does not fire during the original phase (a tiny trace on step 2-3 digit 2 inputs) or at any copy step. Which L=4 sequences fire is only partly predictable from the first token; the predicate over-fires on ~40% of L=4 delimiters and misses the L=5 tail.
